THEN STEP 3 — THE CONSTRUCTOR + THE RENDER PROOF. This is the keystone moment: prove the stateless Zig engine constructs and RENDERS a world from RLE data with NO JS in the construct/render path. The user will see this shot, so it must be real — a shot that secretly routes through the V8 dev host is the exact slice-1 trap and is a FAIL.

Do this in TWO parts, and STOP at the gate in between if needed:

PART A — survey the render path FIRST, report before building blind:
1. Identify the EXACT path that produces a rendered PNG today (what `tools/rjit shot` drives). Determine whether a Zig-NATIVE headless render-to-PNG exists (the stateless render capability driven without the V8 dev host), or whether the only existing render path goes through the V8/JS host.
2. If a Zig-native headless render path EXISTS: proceed to Part B.
3. If the ONLY render path is V8-hosted: STOP and report that as the real architectural finding — do NOT fake a shot through V8, and do NOT claim a render proof you can't honestly produce. We decide the headless-Zig-render scope with the user. (This is a legitimate outcome, not a failure on your part.)

PART B — the constructor (only if Part A finds a clean Zig render path):
1. Build the CONSTRUCTOR: read the fixture game-file's three streams (the gen_gamefile.ts fixture already carries logic+map+skins+manifest+blobs), install/validate the assets into the content store, resolve every tape reference against the installed vocab, and hand the composed data to the EXISTING stateless Zig capabilities (camera/map-render — the smallest renderable: the map stream's tiles/a building piece is enough). No per-game script path — data only.
2. Render the constructed scene to a PNG via the Zig-native path and capture it with `tools/rjit shot` (SELFSHOT-0606 conventions, cite the PNG path).
3. Prove no JS in the construct/render path: grep/inventory that the binary doing the construct+render carries no bundle.js / V8 eval.

REPORT BACK: Part A's finding first. If you reach Part B: the constructor file path, the cited PNG path, the no-JS proof, and `tools/rjit game verify` GREEN. Do NOT wire the editor Compile bake yet — that swaps the hand-authored fixture for editor-emitted streams and is the next step.

Stay in your own context — no Task tool, no subagents. tools/rjit only. No reset/revert. Commit only on my word.

events.text: PART A finding (render-path survey): the ONLY render-to-PNG path is V8-hosted. rjit shot boots the shipped cart binary (zig-out/bin/<cart>) = v8_app.zig, which @embedFile's bundle-<cart>.js and evals it in V8; the reconciler emits CREATE/APPEND/UPDATE mutations; host_tree.applyCommandBatch (host_tree.zig:627) builds the *Node tree SOLELY from that V8 mutation stream; engine.run (engine.zig:3261) is the GPU shell that paints the tree and capture.tick(root:*Node)->gpu.captureScreenshot->stbi_write_png writes the PNG. capture.zig + witness.zig both render the V8-built tree. The HEADLESS/!has_gpu build stubs engine/gpu/capture to empty structs (no render at all). NO Zig-native headless render binary exists. STOPPING at the Part A gate per the task contract — will NOT fake a shot through V8. The feasible Zig-native route (to decide scope with user): a new app-source built WITHOUT V8 but WITH has_gpu, where a constructor synthesizes a host_tree command batch from the gamefile streams (applyCommandBatch already takes plain JSON bytes, not V8 types) then drives gpu+capture; that binary is new work, not existing. Awaiting scope ruling before Part B.

resolution: PLATMOD spine step 3 — the CONSTRUCTOR + the honest render proof. PART A finding: the only existing render-to-PNG path is V8-hosted (v8_app.zig @embedFile's bundle-<cart>.js and evals it; host_tree builds the Node tree solely from the reconciler mutation stream; engine.run paints it; capture reads back). User chose 'build the no-V8 loader binary'. PART B delivered: framework/world/constructor.zig reads the baked game-file via gamefile.zig, runs the dependency gate (installAndValidate: sha256-verify + atomic-install every asset, resolve every reference), then decodes the map stream's tile grid into a renderable Scene — data only, no per-game script. world_loader.zig (new root app-source) is a binary built with -Duse-v8=false: it links the GPU substrate (SDL3+wgpu+framework draw pipelines+capture) and ZERO V8/zero embedded bundle; it constructs the Scene and renders the tiles as colored rects via gpu.zig+rects.zig, then captures its own hidden-window frame to PNG via capture.zig (SELFSHOT-0606). The render is faithful: the fixture's 3x2 tiles [0,0,1,1,1,1] paint as row0 teal/teal/orange, row1 all orange. No-JS proof: the binary carries 0 v8:: symbols, 0 react-reconciler/bundle markers, 0 V8 shared libs, and -Duse-v8=false skips the v8 module + libc_v8.a by construction (build.zig:172-178). One framework change: capture.tick(root:*Node)->?*Node so the loader passes null (no crop); engine's caller coerces, backward-compatible. Wired into tools/rjit: new 'rjit game shot [--out]' verb + folded into 'rjit game verify' (builds loader, renders, asserts PNG+no-V8). GREEN: rjit game verify VERDICT GREEN 1/1 oracle, 2/2 round-trips, 1/1 render, 71/71 suites, 3/3 scripts. PNG: shots/world_loader-keystone.png (+ zig-out/game/world_loader-verify.png in verify). NOT committed (awaiting user word). Editor Compile bake NOT touched (next step).
